text: Stable Video Diffusion identifies three stages for successful training of video latent diffusion models (LDMs): text-to-image pretraining, video pretraining, and high-quality video finetuning. [@chk-eb70fc5d6d3660ae0f95ffa1] A more detailed description of the same three stages is: text-to-image pretraining, video pretraining on a large dataset at low resolution, and high-resolution video finetuning on a much smaller dataset with higher-quality videos. [@chk-aac6ae977da7da1ebb2d98e4] The authors also introduce three distinct stages of video model training which they separately analyze for impact on final performance. [@chk-445957a680ec2c7c979f7934]
